description: Generates standalone production code (C++, Python, Rust) from the current canvas diagram. Returns structured code files, interfaces (inputs/outputs), execution order, and diagnostics.

encapsulateSubsystems.description: Whether to generate encapsulated subsystem classes (default: false)

modelName.description: Name of the generated model class/module (e.g., "MotorController", default: "BlockWerkModel")

sampleTime.description: Optional custom step size in seconds (default: current canvas sampleTime)

target.description: Filter code generation to a specific target language (default: "all")

name: generate_code
title: Generate code
